answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof-of-space, requiring nodes to dedicate verifiable storage plots. Attackers must incur the scarce capital cost of purchasing physical media, such as magnetic drives on ferrous platters, rather than spawning ephemeral aliases that flash and fade like a comet. Under challenge audits, fake nodes lacking allocated sectors fracture like brittle shale. However, this mechanism accelerates storage hardware wear and marginalizes lightweight agents.
